title: Boeing slows hiring, plans job cuts as recovery takes longer than expected
summary: Boeing’s commercial aircraft division plans to reduce about five per cent of its workforce as the company struggles to increase aircraft production and meet delivery targets. The move comes as Boeing rethinks its production timelines after facing ongoing manufacturing and supply-chain challenges.
llm_summary: Boeing’s commercial‑aircraft unit is set to trim roughly five percent of its workforce after production and delivery numbers fell short of expectations. Ongoing manufacturing hiccups and supply‑chain constraints have forced the company to slow hiring and rethink its growth timeline, signaling a longer‑than‑anticipated recovery for its jet‑building operations.
